text: Agile methodology is a popular approach to project management, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything upfront, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. At the start of each sprint, the team selects tasks from a prioritized list called a backlog. The backlog is made up of user stories, which are simple descriptions of features written from a user's perspective. Every day, the team holds a quick standup meeting to share progress and discuss any obstacles. This iterative development process allows teams to deliver working parts of a project regularly, receive feedback early, and make adjustments quickly. As a result, Agile helps teams respond to changes more effectively.
